title: H9 public-kline continuation screen
purpose: Decide whether continued collection of exact H9 force-order and causal order-book data is justified; never claim this proxy is H9 profitability evidence.

data.quality_policy: Reject corrupt ZIPs, duplicate or non-contiguous bars, and incomplete symbol coverage before PnL.

proxy.pressure: absolute signed aggressive quote flow divided by trailing six-bar quote volume; signed aggressive quote flow is 2*taker-buy quote volume minus total quote volume
proxy.threshold: nearest-rank 99.5th percentile over prior 30 calendar days of completed proxy-pressure bars
proxy.recovery: the immediately following 5m bar must not extend the event-direction extreme and must close beyond the event close against pressure
proxy.entry: open of the first 5m bar after the completed recovery bar
proxy.stop: 0.75 times event high-low impulse adverse to entry
proxy.exit: first stop touch or the open 15 minutes after entry; ambiguous stop-at-entry-bar uses stop
proxy.overlap: at most one open proxy trade per symbol
proxy.funding: omitted because maximum hold is 15 minutes; this can slightly overstate or understate events crossing funding settlement

decision.pass: Continue exact H9 collection; proxy pass is not strategy replacement approval.
decision.fail: Stop prioritizing the exact frozen H9 specification and register a materially different mechanism before further collection.
decision.change_policy: Any proxy feature, threshold, recovery, exit or cost change requires a new experiment id.
